description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI class, which is an API endpoint for managing employee salary components within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting salary component records for employees, with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee salary components, including CRUD operations, validations, and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee salary component by employee number and component ID, returns a resource result.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all salary components for a specific employee, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee salary component based on provided request data.

methods.name: setEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Sets salary details on an EmployeeSalary entity from request parameters, validating pay grade and currency.

methods.name: setEmployeeDirectDebitToEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Attaches or removes direct deposit information to/from an EmployeeSalary entity based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing salary component.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee salary components based on IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting salary components.
